missing: Nobody has actually tested these units: no independent real-world data on outage switchover, surge/AC-start performance, failure rates or installer support, and no help sizing to the shopper's own loads and whether they have (or want) solar — every substantive source is a marketplace or installer with a sales interest.
why: Only EnergySage approaches major-reviewer status and it ranks from quote data rather than testing; the rest are installer/marketplace comparisons (useful specs and real prices, but commercially biased) and affiliate listicles, two of which repeat the expired 30% tax credit. Consistent consensus (Powerwall 3 default, aPower 2 for big whole-home, Enphase for microinverter homes) but no second authoritative tested source.
